text:
Maya Chen: Quick check-in for marketplace launch readiness. Need owners for: EdgeBox AMIs/OVAs, GCP/ Azure listing assets, SI demo flow, embargoed blog + press kit, and landing A/B variants. Freeze target: Fri 2025-08-01 18:00 PT. Who can take each?

Roberto Diaz: I can own AMIs/OVAs and the partner images bucket. Will upload EdgeBox AMIs by Thu EOD. Will also create marketplace package tarball.

Liam O'Connor: SI demo is mostly wired but seeing intermittent 401s when the demo broker exchanges service account tokens in staging. Repro steps attached below.

Ava Singh: Marketing will produce: blog draft, press kit zip, and 3 landing variants (self-serve, enterprise, partner co-sell). Localized copy for EN/JP/ES. We'll aim to have drafts by Wed.

LegalBot: Heads-up: export compliance needs checks for EdgeBox images (EdgeBox contains encryption libs). Legal will confirm by Thu 2025-07-31 12:00 PT.

Roberto Diaz: Upload command I'll use:
```bash
partner-cli package upload --src ./edgebox-ami --dest s3://partners-edgebox/releases/2025-07-30 --meta "partner=EdgeBox,ver=1.2.0"
```

Liam O'Connor: Repro snippet for 401:
```bash
# staging demo token exchange
curl -X POST https://staging.auth.redwood.internal/token \
  -d "client_id=demo-client&assertion=$JWT" | jq .
# response sometimes 401 with {\"error\":\"invalid_grant\"}
```

Maya Chen: Assigning owners: Roberto => EdgeBox images + marketplace package; Liam => SI demo + token triage; Ava => blog/press + landing + localization; LegalBot => compliance signoff. Can everyone ack?

Roberto Diaz: ack. AMIs will be in partner bucket and I'll post checksum before freeze.

Liam O'Connor: ack, working with infra to trace token expiry. If unresolved by freeze, we'll switch demo to demo-client-local (no SSO) and flag in runbook.

Ava Singh: ack — blog embargo draft ready for review by Thu AM. Need approved hero image from Roberto's staging URL.

release-bot: CI: marketplace-listing-build #451 succeeded :white_check_mark: artifacts at https://artifacts.redwood.internal/marketplace/451

Maya Chen: Embargo proposal: 2025-08-03T16:00Z. PR team to lift. Ava please confirm final time with PR.

Ava Singh: Confirmed. PR team will lift at 2025-08-03T16:00Z if legal signs off. I'll coordinate cadence.

Maya Chen: Added runbook note: if token exchange persists, demo fallback = static recorded demo + QA checklist. Link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/marketplace-edgebox

Roberto Diaz: staging preview link for hero/screenshots: https://staging.marketplace.redwood.dev/edgebox — creds in 1Password. I'll snapshot hero at 1200x628 for blog.

Liam O'Connor: Infra pointed out a clock skew on one staging node causing token validations to fail. Patching now. Will post patch CL.

Maya Chen: Great. We'll do a full dry-run Mon 2025-08-03 09:00 PT. Calendar invite sent. Last call Tue EOD for signoffs. Thanks all :rocket:
